study.question: Can an orthogonal change of fresh factor coordinates recover rank88 click AUC and measured prediction utility without restoring the eight discarded directions? Observation: g2-r0064-energy_rank96_native reproduces click AUC 0.6675003890552496; g2-r0064-energy_rank88_native gives 0.6671251297972951 (loss 0.0003752592579545), and g2-r0064-energy_rank88_high gives 0.6671593751174643 (loss 0.0003410139377853). Energy restoration recovers only 0.0000342453201692. At rank96, lowering energy gives 0.6674020187039185. Thus energy alone does not explain the observed rank contrast under this one seed; rank loss, coordinate-dependent optimization and numerical effects remain alternatives. g2-r0063-context_gauge96_output loses 0.0004137597046746 at unchanged rank/product over real arithmetic, showing sensitivity to factor scaling, not yet orthogonal basis. Rank80 also lost accuracy; earlier norm35 remained below the incumbent, so neither rank nor energy improvement is monotone. Identical rank96 receipts have model p50 around 14.92-15.27ms and whole-validation inference 24.92-27.56s: timing is noisy. All prior runs are one fixed initialization, not independent seed evidence. candidate_diagnostics are not_requested: receipts verify execution/scores but do not establish all tensor invariants.
study.hypothesis: SVD-aligned balanced context factors may expose an unfavorable coordinate system to the frozen elementwise AdamW optimizer at reduced rank. Deterministic orthogonal mixing can change that optimization geometry while preserving the initial context map, each factor singular spectrum/Frobenius norm, rank, product energy, parameter count and forward graph over real arithmetic. A rank-by-basis factorial distinguishes a reduced-rank-specific effect from a general basis effect. This is a provisional optimization hypothesis, not evidence that discarded directions are redundant.

nearest_work.difference: Direct failed local predecessor: rank-by-product-energy factorial. Its rank88 energy-restored candidate remained below rank96. Here fix product and spectra at each rank and change only the latent orthogonal coordinates; no energy scaling.

Same-rank nonorthogonal output-heavy gauge lost AUC. Orthogonal DCT mixing preserves both factor spectra and norms, unlike shifting singular magnitude between factors. The previous gauge is counterevidence against generic coordinate changes, not confirmation of this one.

Pinned primary implementation lines203-211 uses two linear factors for attention projections; our two-linear form is inherited, not novel. This experiment concerns only constructor coordinates in the existing buy context map, retaining history compression and semantic local branches; no HiFormer architecture reproduction.

Authorized registry supplies provenance/link only; detailed original text is unavailable and its benchmark fallback was read. No original-paper equivalence or priority claim is made. Orthogonal factor reparameterization is treated as standard linear algebra; novelty remains unverified.

inherited_components: All incumbent representation, masking, action-aware scorer, five detail summaries and task prediction paths.
Buy-only upstream context ownership; item/scorer auxiliary stop-gradients and cart/fav context isolation.
Fresh untrained semantic packed affine, CPU FP32 SVD, balanced rank96/88 factors and unchanged native two-linear forward.

study.proposed_difference: At construction only, after inherited SVD/sign canonicalization, form orthonormal DCT-II Q in CPU FP64 then cast to FP32. Replace input A by Q A and output B by B Q^T. Clone only compact trainable factors; discard Q and all spectral temporaries. The two native controls are byte-identical to their authorized sources. New modules add explicit owner_context_basis=svd|dct; the svd branch is a no-op. No learnable coefficients or forward operators are added. Rank88 retains 112 nonlinear channels and saves2432 Parameters/context MACs per example versus rank96 (304 per latent direction, context width192/output112); both remain larger than a single dense context map.
predictions: Frozen selection gate before any new scoring: candidate click AUC must be >= contemporaneous native96 AUC-0.0001 AND >= joint-entry AUC0.666753547526167-0.0002=0.666553547526167. The stronger incumbent gate matters here. These are practical preservation thresholds, not significance tests; do not relax them after scoring.

At fixed rank, DCT and native initial products agree within FP32 relative max error1e-4, factor spectra/norms within1e-4 and orthogonality error <=1e-5; non-context parameters/RNG/buffers agree exactly. Model forward structure and storage sizes stay identical. Initial FP32 predictions need numerical agreement, not bit equality; report BF16 differences independently.

Reduced-rank-specific support requires delta88=AUC(88,DCT)-AUC(88,native) >=0.0002 and interaction delta88-delta96 >=0.0001, with the preservation gate also passing. A comparable gain at both ranks supports a general coordinate effect only. AUC recovery alone does not establish a capacity mechanism or efficiency.

Promotion as an efficiency candidate additionally requires measured dense/total storage lower than native96, model-only p50 latency at least1% lower, p95 no more than1% worse, whole-validation inference no more than1% worse, and training wall no more than5% worse under matched host conditions. Timing differences within observed repeat noise are inconclusive, not cost savings; require confirmation in later authorized timing repetitions before a supported claim.

Report all four AUC/logloss values, auxiliary mean separately, model/embedding/dense counts, training/wall/allocated GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, throughput/p50/p95 and inherited history-length slices with counts/positives/negatives. No unapproved new input, slice data or assessment feedback is needed.
falsifiers: Nonfinite outputs/loss/gradients, changed masked-ID invariance, wrong four-task shapes, non-context initialization/RNG drift, persistent rotation storage, missing optimizer factors or violated gradient ownership invalidate the implementation before interpretation.

Rank88 DCT misses either frozen AUC gate, or gains <0.0002, or interaction <0.0001: reject the reduced-rank-specific rescue hypothesis at this bounded initialization. Equal gains at both ranks do not support rank-specific rescue.

No measured prediction cost reduction rejects practical utility even if AUC recovers; fewer parameters/MACs alone is insufficient. Loss of accuracy rejects this candidate, not every orthogonal basis or all capacity reduction.
BF16-only divergence with absent FP32 optimization difference leaves a numerical explanation; no claim that AdamW is the sole cause without a separately authorized discriminating control.

Native controls must reproduce authorized AUCs within1e-6 at frozen seed under matching execution; otherwise stop interpretation and diagnose drift without changing the protocol. Repeated same-seed reproduction is not seed robustness.
alternative_explanations: AdamW second moments are coordinate dependent even when factor products/singular spectra match; this is the proposed optimization intervention, not extra representational capacity.
FP32 rotation/SVD and BF16 contractions introduce rounding differences. Same-initial-state FP32 parity and separate BF16 diagnostics are prerequisites.
One deterministic DCT per rank is one mechanism contrast, not a general rotation theorem; DCT orientation differs by rank.
Training global dense clipping couples tasks; retained gradient ownership does not isolate later click changes to a single embedding path.
Small arithmetic reduction may yield no timing benefit; shared host/load noise and one fixed seed limit attribution.
